task_as_i_read_it.description: the task as you read it, in your own words, one or two sentences, written before the work. The manager compares it with what was sent, so a misreading shows here.

narrowest_reading.description: only if the task was ambiguous: the narrowest reading you took, and what the other reading would have been. Empty if it was not ambiguous.

followups.description: work you found that mattered and did not do, one line each. Empty if there is none.

findings.description: what is still wrong, one object per finding, only inside the range the task gave. Each carries four things: where, steps_to_reproduce, expected, actual — nothing you cannot point at. An empty list is the report for a clean pass.

where.description: a file and a line, or how to reach the behaviour.

steps_to_reproduce.description: the exact steps that trigger it.

one_true_thing.description: one line: what would most change how the next task is planned. Say so if there is nothing.
